profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at ExtraHop
profile.summary: I am a software engineer who enjoys doing the hard work necessary to make solutions to difficult, complex problems that appear simple to end users.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: I am excited to join ExtraHop Networks as a Senior Software Engineer.  Our mission is to help enterprises detect and understand threats to their networks quickly and reliably, enabling them to rise above the noise.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
I was a senior developer on a team that built the next generation ecommerce platform for the world's best fashion retailer.  Our team is an agile, full-stack group building a set of cloud-native, microservice applications that powers the nordstrom.com navigation infrastructure and enables new business analytics.

I am experienced with React.js, Node.js, Java, Spring Boot, and with many AWS technologies including Lambdas, EC2, DynamoDB, Elastic Beanstalk, Elastic Load Balancing, SNS, SQS, S3, and CloudFormation.

Our team is DevOps-focussed, and we can have code running in production within minutes of merging to our Master branch.  We are responsible, accountable, and on call for the full stack.

I am experienced in collaborating with diverse global teams, enjoy travel, and am comfortable using collaboration tools such as Slack, BlueJeans, Google Hangouts, JIRA, Github, and Bitbucket.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: At HPE in Seattle, I was a software design engineer working on the HPE Helion Cloud platform, focusing on  OpenStack network services such as Load Balancing as a Service (LBaaS) and Virtual Private Network as a Service (VPNaas).  I was an active upstream contributor to several OpenStack modules, and  a core reviewer for the neutron-lbaas, neutron-lbaas-dashboard and neutron-vpnaas projects, and attended several OpenStack summits and mid-cycle meetups.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: During my time with HP in Fort Collins, I worked on a variety of projects related to system management software for HP Unix workstations and servers.   My code was predominantly written in C, Java, and JavaScript, and ran the gamut from system bootloader firmware to web interfaces.
